format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: the root is a progressbar named by label, its valuenow the value

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#p1 .sf-progress-bar'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'progressbar' && r.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Загрузка файлов' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '65' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuemin') === '0' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuemax') === '100' && !r.hasAttribute('tabindex'); })()

probes.title: without label the host's aria-label names the progressbar (§3.1)
value is a number; writing it moves valuenow
chunk {done, total} shows a part of a job in per cent
tone and setProgress still answer, each use noted with its dates
warning-at and error-at turn the tone by themselves, the more serious of status and the threshold is drawn and said as data-status

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#p6'); const b = document.querySelector('#p7'); return a.getAttribute('data-status') === 'warning' && a.querySelector('.sf-progress-bar').classList.contains('sf-progress-bar--warning') && b.getAttribute('data-status') === 'error'; })()

probes.title: indeterminate leaves the value unsaid: no aria-valuenow, no percentage text, the segment class; taken off, the same bar fills from the value (C34)
paused is at least a warning and is said in the value text; an error stays an error (C34)

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#p9'); const r = a.querySelector('.sf-progress-bar'); const b = document.querySelector('#p10'); return a.getAttribute('data-status') === 'warning' && r.classList.contains('sf-progress-bar--warning') && r.getAttribute('aria-valuetext') === '35 %, на паузе' && b.getAttribute('data-status') === 'error'; })()

probes.title: text-position top: one line over the bar, the label at the start and the value at the end, aria-hidden; bottom is read as top (C131 (4))

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#p11 .sf-progress-bar'); const h = r.firstElementChild; const o = document.querySelector('#p12 .sf-progress-bar'); return r.dataset.position === 'top' && h.classList.contains('sf-progress-bar-head') && h.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' && h.querySelector('.sf-progress-bar-label').textContent.trim() === 'Загрузка' && h.querySelector('.sf-progress-bar-text').textContent.trim() === '42%' && h.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('sf-progress-bar-main') && o.dataset.position === 'top' && o.querySelector('.sf-progress-bar-head'); })()

probes.title: meter gives role meter with the value (C131 (7))

steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#p13 .sf-progress-bar'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'meter' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '74' && r.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Место'; })()

(() => { const r = document.querySelector('#p13 .sf-progress-bar'); return r.getAttribute('role') === 'meter' && r.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '74' && !r.classList.contains('sf-progress-bar--indeterminate'); })()

probes.title: no status carries no class and draws primary; neutral is its own grey class; primary is read as the default (C131 (1))

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#p1 .sf-progress-bar'); const n = document.querySelector('#p14 .sf-progress-bar'); const o = document.querySelector('#p15 .sf-progress-bar'); const none = (r) => !/sf-progress-bar--(neutral|primary|info|success|warning|error)/.test(r.className); return none(a) && none(o) && n.classList.contains('sf-progress-bar--neutral') && document.querySelector('#p14').getAttribute('data-status') === 'neutral' && !document.querySelector('#p1').hasAttribute('data-status'); })()
